parameters.name: appNameList
parameters.description: Filters the results by one or more application names.

parameters.name: displayNameKeyword
parameters.description: The keyword for a fuzzy search on display names.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The next token for keyset pagination. Omit this parameter for the first page. For subsequent pages, use the `nextToken` value from the previous response.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The sort property. To ensure consistent traversal, we recommend setting this to `id`.

parameters.name: ownerIdList
parameters.description: Filters the results by one or more owner IDs.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve. This parameter is used for page-based pagination.

parameters.name: pagination
parameters.description: The pagination mode. Currently, only keyset pagination is supported.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort order. For consistent traversal, we recommend using ascending order.

parameters.name: stateList
parameters.description: Filters the results by one or more states.
